THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Split Plate Emergency Kebab Night

Same brand. Two SKUs. Adults get Colonel Kababz Chicken Seekh (slight kick). Kids get Colonel Kababz Beef Seekh (mild, less spicy). Same macros, different heat — the rare frozen split where the brand does the work for you.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME20 min
COOK METHODAir fryer
EST. / SERVING~460 cal | ~32g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: AIR FRYER CHAR IS NOT OPTIONAL. Per-box heat instructions get the kebabs warm; the air fryer 5 min @ 400°F finish is what gives them char + texture + flavor. Skipping this is why frozen kebabs taste like frozen kebabs.

Ingredients

TIER 2 PROTEIN (split by SKU)

  • 1 box Colonel Kababz Chicken Seekh Kabab (8 large, 11 oz frozen) [adult]
  • 1 box Colonel Kababz Beef Seekh Kabab (8 large, 11 oz frozen) [kid]

ADULT FINISH

  • 2-3 tbsp green chutney (drizzle on salad + dip)
  • Cucumber slices (thin half-moons)
  • Fresh lime wedge (optional)

Option 1

  • Cucumber sticks (4-5 per kid)
  • (Optional) tiny ramekin of green chutney as a dip if they ask

TIER 3 CARB

  • 1 pack Vadilal Quick Treat Rumali Roti (6 pieces, 240g frozen) — OR substitute Haldiram's Minute Khana Phulka Roti

TIER 4 FRESHNESS

  • 1 medium red onion, sliced paper-thin
  • 1 medium cucumber
  • Store-bought green chutney (cilantro-mint based) — any brand
  • Pinch of salt

Option 2

  • Cucumber sticks (4-5 per kid)
  • (Optional) tiny ramekin of green chutney as a dip if they ask

Allergens: gluten, dairy.

AT THE BOX. Adults get Colonel Kababz Chicken Seekh (slight kick). Kids get Colonel Kababz Beef Seekh (mild). Both boxes go in the air fryer together — same time, same temp. Zero workflow split until plating.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.AIR FRY KEBABS. Both boxes (chicken + beef) into the air fryer together, 400°F for 12 min total. Shake basket at 6 min. THE LAST 5 MIN gets you the char that matters — don't pull early.
  2. 2.SLICE ONION + SALT. Paper-thin half-moons of red onion. Sprinkle a pinch of salt. Let sit 5 min — salt mellows the raw bite. (This is the Tier 4 move that punches above its weight.)
  3. 3.CUCUMBER STICKS (kid) + CUCUMBER SLICES (adult): Slice cucumber into sticks for the kid tray. Thin half-moons for the adult salad.
  4. 4.WARM RUMALI. Wrap in damp paper towel. Microwave 30 sec total. Don't over-warm or it dries out.

Adult — Chicken Seekh + Wrap + Onion-Chutney Salad

  1. 5.ADULT SALAD. Combine salted red onion + cucumber slices + 1 tbsp green chutney + tiny pinch more salt. Toss. This is the freshness anchor — without it, the plate is one-dimensional.
  2. 6.WRAP ONE KEBAB. Take one chicken seekh, place it on a warm rumali, fold the rumali around it. THIS is the plate-interaction move that elevates the visual.
  3. 7.PLATE. Wrapped kebab + 1-2 unwrapped chicken seekh on the side + folded rumali underneath + small ramekin of onion-cucumber-chutney salad. Optional: lime wedge.

Kid — Beef Seekh + Plain Rumali + Cucumber · Option 1

  1. 5.PLATE. Bento tray. 1 beef seekh + 1 folded rumali (or one rolled around a half-kebab if they like burritos) + 4-5 cucumber sticks in another compartment. Done.

Kid — Beef Seekh + Plain Rumali + Cucumber · Option 2

  1. 5.Add a 1-tbsp ramekin of green chutney to the divided tray. Don't push — they'll dip if they want.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Chicken Seekh + Wrap + Onion-Chutney Salad: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Beef Seekh + Plain Rumali + Cucumber: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Two boxes, one basket: Beef Seekh + Chicken Seekh in the same air fryer at the same time. They cook identically. Pull together.
  • Slice red onion THIN — paper-thin half-moons. Salt them, let them sit 5 min while the kebabs cook. The salt mellows the harsh raw bite.

If something fails

Kebabs look pale / flabby: Skipped the air fryer char step. 5 min @ 400°F AFTER the heat-through is non-negotiable. Real char = real flavor + real photo.

Adult kebabs too spicy: Use the beef variant for everyone. Same macros, less heat. Or add yogurt to the plate to cut the heat.

Kid won't eat the kebab: Use the BEEF variant. Chicken seekh has more spice. Or strip the kebab off the skewer onto plain rumali and let them eat it like a soft taco.

Rumali roti cracks when folding: Cold rumali cracks. Microwave 30 sec wrapped in a damp paper towel. Don't over-microwave or it dries out.

Salad too harsh / raw onion bite: Slice the onion THIN and salt it 5 min before serving. Salt + time mellows the bite. Skip if your kids hate raw onion entirely — cucumber sticks alone are fine.

Plate looks sad in photos: Three fixes: (1) char marks visible on kebabs (air fryer finish). (2) Wrap one kebab in the rumali on the adult plate. (3) Add green chutney drizzle — color contrast is the cheapest visual upgrade.

Storage and reheating

Store: Kebabs: keep frozen until cook day. Cooked leftover kebabs keep 2 days in fridge. Rumali roti: stays frozen 6 months. Onion-cucumber salad: best fresh, same day only.

Reheat: Kebabs: air fryer 350°F for 3 min to re-crisp. Rumali: 20 sec microwave in damp paper towel.

Lasts: Cooked kebabs 2 days. Frozen components: months. Salad: same day.

Make this when

It's 6 PM, nobody planned, everyone's tired, and the DoorDash math is heading toward $80 for mediocre food. You don't need to cook — you need to ASSEMBLE. Frozen kebab + frozen rumali + a 5-minute onion-cucumber salad = a real Indian family dinner in 20 minutes.

Brands I use

Colonel Kababz
Chicken Seekh Kabab (8 large, 11 oz)
Tier 2 protein for ADULTS. Halal, fully cooked, minced chicken with herbs + spices. Slightly spiced — adults get the kick. Same brand as the beef variant so cooking is identical.
Colonel Kababz
Beef Seekh Kabab (8 large, 11 oz)
Tier 2 protein for KIDS. Same brand, same macros, milder than the chicken version. The split-cook is done by SKU selection, not by cooking differently.
Vadilal Quick Treat
Rumali Roti (6 pieces, 240g)
Tier 3 carb. Thin, flexible, restaurant-style — the ONLY frozen roti that folds around a kebab cleanly. 30 sec microwave. Don't substitute for paratha (too thick).
Haldiram's
Minute Khana Phulka Roti (12 pieces)
Tier 3 carb alternative. Whole wheat, thicker, more traditional. Use when rumali isn't available or for kids who prefer something more substantial.
